meta.method: ZIP polygon = geo.zip_membership_boundary (canonical); city limits = Denton County GIS City_Limit/0 (+ Census TIGERweb incorporated places for parts outside the county layer); ETJ = Denton County GIS ETJ_GC/1; area shares are geodesic ST_Area ratios; no radius logic. SRID 4269/4326 differences (~1 m) ignored.
limitations: ETJ outside Denton County is UNKNOWN (county layer does not cover it); ZIPs extending into Dallas/Collin/Tarrant/Cooke counties show that share as city or 'outside county'.
Census place boundaries lag annexations; the county layer's last-edit dates are 2025-2026.
Stored-record attribution is ZIP-level (serving membership), not jurisdiction-level: a stored record is not geolocated to a city here.
Texas permit-authority text is a statutory generalization, not verified per jurisdiction.
PO Box ZIPs 75027, 75029, 76202, 76204, 76206 are out of scope (no geographic area).

frisco-active-building-permits.scope: City of Frisco active building permits (all ISSUED). Registry coverage declares Collin+Denton because Frisco straddles the county line.

denton-county-dev-permits.scope: Denton County DEV_Permits (county-issued development permits). FROZEN: layer-wide newest 2023-06-09 (docs/denton-data-integrity-launch-gate-2026-10-10.md s1).

fort-worth-development-permits.scope: City of Fort Worth development permits.

dallas-specific-use-permits.scope: City of Dallas specific-use (zoning) permits only.

txdot-projects-info-all.scope: TxDOT statewide road projects: state highway work, NOT a local land-development permit authority; shown for completeness, ignored for gap.

meta.disclaimer: General Texas framework, NOT verified against any city's ordinances, interlocal agreements or the county's rules: municipalities regulate (zoning, building permits) inside their limits; a city's subdivision/plat authority also reaches its ETJ (Local Gov't Code ch. 212); counties have no zoning power and only limited authority (plat approval in unincorporated areas under ch. 232, plus floodplain / on-site sewage / 911 addressing programs). Which office actually issues a given permit in a given spot must be confirmed with that jurisdiction.

permit_authority.basis: General Texas framework, NOT verified against any city's ordinances, interlocal agreements or the county's rules: municipalities regulate (zoning, building permits) inside their limits; a city's subdivision/plat authority also reaches its ETJ (Local Gov't Code ch. 212); counties have no zoning power and only limited authority (plat approval in unincorporated areas under ch. 232, plus floodplain / on-site sewage / 911 addressing programs). Which office actually issues a given permit in a given spot must be confirmed with that jurisdiction.
